project_type: Python microservices payment-decisioning POC (ACIP). uv workspace monorepo: a shared lib libs/acip-common, an isolated ML project ml/, demo scripts scripts/, infra-only Docker Compose under deploy/. Phase 2 adds 7 FastAPI services under services/*.
build_system: uv 0.5.4 workspace. Root pyproject.toml has [tool.uv.workspace] members = ['libs/*'] and [tool.uv.sources] acip-common = { workspace = true }; Phase 2 must add 'services/*' to members. Each service is its own workspace member pyproject declaring a path/workspace dep on acip-common. The ml/ project is a SEPARATE uv project (not a workspace member) to keep the heavy ML stack isolated; it depends on acip-common by editable path. Dev tooling + scripts deps live in the root [dependency-groups] dev group. QUIRK: system clock is set to 2026, so trained model artifact filenames carry 2026 dates (resolve via model_card.json, never hardcode).
test_framework: pytest 8.3.4 (pinned in root dev group). Tests live per-package under tests/test_*.py. acip-common already has tests under libs/acip-common/tests/.
build_command: uv sync  (then per-service nothing extra; services install via workspace). Docker images build via: docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml build
test_command: uv run pytest libs/acip-common services   (per package: uv run pytest services/<name>)
verification_instructions: Run the full gate from repo root: 1) uv sync; 2) uv run ruff check . ; 3) uv run black --check . ; 4) uv run mypy libs/acip-common/src services ; 5) uv run pytest libs/acip-common services ; 6) docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml config (validates compose). For the end-to-end core-path smoke: make up, then POST /v1/checkout to checkout-api on its published host port with a clean transaction and confirm a JSON decision returns with NO agents running and NO cloud creds (orchestrator deadline -> decide_partial -> configured missing-verdict default; llm-gateway on mock). Clean up temp files after.
snapshot_or_generated_files: ml/models/ holds trained artifacts (gitignored): risk-xgb-<date>.json (XGBoost save_model JSON), fraud-lgbm-<date>.txt (LightGBM booster text), model_card.json indexing them under models.risk.artifact / models.fraud.artifact. Produce them with: make train (cd ml && uv run python training/generate_dataset.py && uv run python training/train.py). ml/data/*.parquet also gitignored. ml-scoring-service must read model_card.json to find the current artifacts; if absent it serves a deterministic heuristic.
environment_constraints: Stack MUST run with NO cloud creds: llm-gateway degrades to MockAdapter when LLM_PROVIDER=gemini but ADC resolution fails/absent. ml-scoring-service serves a heuristic when model artifacts are missing. Only checkout-api exposes a host port; all other services are internal on the acip-net Compose network. Do NOT modify docs/*. Do NOT build the six agents or graph-projector (Phase 3). The infra-only compose stack (redpanda, kafka-init, neo4j, postgres, redis, prometheus, grafana, jaeger) must keep working after services are added.
contribution_requirements: Keep all Phase 1 files intact except: (a) the KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP fix in libs/acip-common/src/acip_common/config.py and .env.example, (b) adding services/* to root pyproject workspace members + new Phase 2 config keys, (c) compose + Makefile extensions. Pin all new deps to exact versions. Secrets via env only. Match existing code style: from __future__ import annotations, full docstrings citing doc sections (e.g. 'docs/06 §1'), mypy strict compliance (the root [tool.mypy] is strict=true), ruff rules E/F/I/UP/B/W, black + ruff line-length 100.
key_patterns: acip-common is the single source of contracts; import, never redefine. Kafka wire format is EventEnvelope JSON keyed by transaction_id (acip_common.kafka.EventProducer/EventConsumer). Topic names (txn.lifecycle, txn.evaluate, agent.verdicts, decision.log + .dlq) are NOT the dotted event-type strings - docs/03 §2 maps them; Phase 2 adds acip_common/topics.py with constants + topic_for(event_type). Settings reads docs/07 §2 env vars with defaults so the stack boots with no .env. Decision thresholds/weights come from Settings (approve_max/challenge_max/fraud_block_threshold/w_risk/w_fraud), never hardcoded. Structured JSON logging via acip_common.logging.configure_logging + bind_trace_id(trace_id from the event envelope). Every service: FastAPI app with GET /healthz + GET /readyz. seed.py already defines the Postgres read-model tables (transactions, decisions, agent_verdicts, event_journal) and the Neo4j model (Customer/Device/MethodType/Processor + USED_METHOD_TYPE, LINKED_TO edges).

pyproject.toml (root; ADD services/* to workspace members)
Makefile (stubbed demo/logs + app-service targets to flesh out)

directory_structure: docs/ (00-07 design set, DO NOT EDIT). libs/acip-common/src/acip_common/ (config, schemas, features, kafka, logging; ADD topics). ml/ (training/ + models/, isolated uv project). scripts/ (seed.py; ADD optional demo.py). deploy/ (docker-compose.yml infra-only + prometheus/ grafana/). services/<14 dirs> currently just .gitkeep; Phase 2 fills: checkout-api, commerce-orchestrator, decision-engine, ml-scoring-service, representation-service, llm-gateway, payment-processor-sim. The other 7 (risk-agent, fraud-agent, routing-agent, policy-agent, merchant-agent, checkout-personalization-agent, graph-projector) stay empty until Phase 3.
